basic_info.description: Modern Luxe Living in Lively Excelsior! Experience the pinnacle of modern living at 807 Vienna Street, down-to-the-studs 2020 remodel designed for the discerning homeowner. This exceptional hidden gem blends luxury, comfort, and convenience in one beautifully curated package. Enjoy 3 spacious bedrooms and 3 full baths, plus a versatile flex room perfect as a 4th bedroom, office, or media space. Radiant heat floors run throughout, offering year-round warmth and comfort. The custom kitchen is a culinary dream with ample storage and a professional-grade Bertazzoni appliances. Bathrooms feature high-end Room & Board vanities, while walk-in closets in every bedroom and extra storage in the downstairs suite keep things organized. Indoor-outdoor living shines with an upstairs deck leading to a sunny, Zen, and low-maintenance turf backyard-ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Additional perks include an attached garage, driveway parking, Google Nest doorbell camera, steps away from McLaren Park, and unbeatable commuter access: walkable to Balboa Park BART, bus stops, and near 101 & 280. 807 Vienna Street isn't just a home-it's a lifestyle, where luxury meets thoughtful practicality in every detail.
